description: This file manages tab and session state for the Notesnook app, including tab history, session storage, and tab operations such as creation, removal, navigation, and session loading.

classes.name: TabHistory
classes.description: Manages the history of tab IDs, allowing adding, removing, restoring last, and retrieving the history list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a tab ID to the history, moving it to the top if it already exists.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a tab ID from the history.

methods.name: restoreLast
methods.description: Restores and removes the most recent tab ID from the history.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current tab ID history.
